row.title: A cybernetics research program is data: six studies and four register readings, no new loop
row.body: CYBERNETICS-PROGRAM-1: Conant and Ashby 1970, Ashby 1956, Beer 1972, Powers 1973, the Ashby journal register and von Foerster 1974 are research/studies files whose findings are measured by foundation/research.py from this repository's registers (failure modes, concepts, managers, goals). Papers are regenerated by research --page and posted by the existing thought loop; tests pass (tests/foundation/test_research.py), verified by research --check on 12 studies. Four findings are not met today and file their own Q-RES items.

title: A cybernetics research program is data: six studies and four register readings, no new loop
